card.name: Nutrition facts about fats, protein, vitamins
card.fires_on: Verbs, linking words and number-range marks in plain nutrition text about what fats, protein and vitamins do or how much is recommended. It fires on words like provide, supply, help, also, and on the space or dash inside intake ranges.
